explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/396: 'Is it true that for every k there exists n such that ∏_{0≤i≤k}(n−i) | C(2n,n)?' The Lean statement ∀ k, ∃ n, descFactorial n (k+1) ∣ centralBinom n, with descFactorial n (k+1) = n(n−1)⋯(n−k). Degenerate n ≤ k cannot give spurious solutions: then the product is 0, and 0 divides only 0, while C(2n,n) ≥ 1. Faithful (positive form of the yes/no question).
